resources.string: Applies only to this provider. Changes take effect immediately for the current app. Listening history uses actual playback. Controls are included in style backups.
Hide this provider’s primary and secondary lyric lines.
Hide the primary line and retain available subtitles.
Hide translations, romanization and additional subtitles below the primary line.
Milliseconds, from -30000 to 30000. Positive values delay lyrics; negative values advance them. Zero keeps original timing. Plain text can be delayed but cannot be shown before it arrives.
